provider: Wellcome Trust - storage as a claimable grant cost

free_tier.stated: No byte quota - 'large-scale data storage' is an allowable service charge, plus a 'Data management and sharing plan costs' line.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Funded as a project cost if justified in the data management plan.

chaining: The DMP is the lever: storage written into a data management and sharing plan becomes a funded cost for the grant's duration, renewable with the grant.
limits_note: Grants are held by an administering organisation, not an individual - the applicant needs a host institution. Costs are tied to the award period; storage is not funded in perpetuity.
reliability_note: Reliable funder, but the individual cannot be the grantee.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
